h: Wine Repairs Sorrow Until Shabbos Brings Complete Rest

p: At the third meal of Shabbos
our Sages, of blessed memory, did not institute
and wine to the bitter of soul.'"
Now this needs to be understood:
after all, there is wine used for a mitzvah,
"One who wishes to pour a libation of wine
and similarly we find that Rav Nachman
"As long as I have not drunk
so we see that he needed wine
is fit to make Kiddush over
and to say over it all the songs and praises
wine is only for the bitter of soul,
as is mentioned in the curses:
"in sorrow shall you eat of it" (Bereishis 3:17).

"'And He adds no sorrow with it' (Mishlei 10:22):
כְּמָה דְאַתְּ אָמַר (שְׁמוּאֵל ב יט, ג)
"'And He was saddened in His heart' (Bereishis 6:6):
and sadness means nothing other than mourning;
He mourned over His world, etc."
the halachos that had been forgotten
in the days of mourning for Moshe,
"And his mother called his name Yaabetz,
saying, 'For I bore him in sorrow'";
that is, he came to rectify
the sorrow that the Nachash brought.
which comes to rectify the "much vexation,"
"For in much wisdom is much vexation."
לְבִלְתִּי עׇצְבִּי (דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים א ד, י)
"that it not grieve me" (Divrei HaYamim I 4:10),
meaning that the yetzer hara should not overpower me
(as they said in the Gemara there, Temurah 16a).
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ סוּכָּה כ, סוֹף עַמּוּד א)
(as they said, Sukkah 20a, end of the amud),
"'And the gold of that land is good' (Bereishis 2:12):
this teaches that there is no Torah
like the Torah of Eretz Yisrael,
like the wisdom of Eretz Yisrael."
That is, according to what they said
who are pleasant to one another in halachah;
these are the talmidei chachamim of Bavel,
who wound one another in halachah";
they would accept from one another
Therefore, at the beginning of their entry
And for this wine was needed:
"One who wishes to pour a libation of wine
to gladden the heart of man
from the sorrow of the Nachash.
after there was already orlah and refuse;
"And they drank and became merry with him" (Bereishis 43:34)
that he had been sold as a slave,
whether he had rectified it properly,
and also whether the sons of Yisrael
so he drank wine with them.
And this was at a Shabbos meal,
only after the corruption of the Nachash,
and refinements were needed in this.
And this is called "to comfort mourners,"
וַאֲשַׁלֵּם נִחוּמִים לוֹ וְלַאֲבֵלָיו (יְשַׁעְיָה נז, יח)
"'And I will repay comfort to him and to his mourners' (Yeshayahu 57:18):
But without the corruption of the Nachash,
there would have been no bitterness of soul at all,
and wine would not have been needed
to comfort and to settle the mind.

"Remember the day of Shabbos to sanctify it" (Shemos 20:8),
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב צב, ב)
a place in which there is no forgetting,
and forgetting does not exist there."
lest the yetzer hara gain the upper hand,
as is written in the holy Zohar
עֲמָלֵק יוֹשֵׁב בְּאֶרֶץ הַנֶּגֶב (בְּמִדְבַּר יג, כט)
"'Amalek dwells in the land of the Negev' (Bamidbar 13:29),
That is, "in the land of the Negev":
that it is found even in a person
who is dried out and clean
of all the desires of this world,
a house that is dried out of all good";
to enter even into Gan Eden
and this too is for the bitter of soul
to rectify the sorrow from the Nachash.
they instituted the cup of Birkas HaMazon
(as was explained in Parshas Lech Lecha);
only to set the heart straight
And one needs to set the heart straight
"And for the upright of heart, joy."

And similarly the mitzvah of libations,
which is a mitzvah stated explicitly in the Torah
it would have been better for him to say,

comes only when one is saved from trouble,

And about this it is stated
with what does it gladden God?
From here we learn that Shirah is said
that is with joy and goodness of heart?
You must say, this is Shirah."
meaning to set the heart straight.
And this is what libations indicate:
that Hashem Yisbarach is at rest
And this is why it says here,
after the parsha of the spies,
that they would be in the wilderness
the parsha of libations is stated,
to the land of your dwellings";
I gave it to Avraham, etc.,
and a son inherits the father, etc."
is it called "the land of your dwellings,"

But this comes to tell them
that after they went wrong with the spies,
when you come to Eretz Yisrael
and you will be at rest
(בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה רֵישׁ פָּרָשַׁת וַיֵּשֶׁב, פד, ג)
even so they will not have
had it been according to the will of Hashem Yisbarach,
who wished to bring them in immediately,
"And the Aron of the covenant of Hashem, etc.,
to seek out a resting place for them"
for then there would have been
as there will be in the future.
of the three traits of the Avos.
but because of the wickedness of the nations, etc.,

which is the merit of the Avos;
and it is a possession held by inheritance
is at rest and has joy from this,

p: to rectify the sorrow of the Nachash,
so that it not come in to entice,
where there is room to forget.
and it will help even for the weekdays
to be saved from the accusation
which is at the completion of Shabbos,
for they said in Midrash Rabbah
(חֵלֶק ב, פָּרָשָׁה כה, שְׁמוֹת רַבָּה כה, יב)
"Today, if you will listen to His voice."
And as for what they said (Shabbos 118b),
is judged according to its majority.
and is saved from the three calamities.
And as they said in the Mechilta:
"He who keeps Shabbos from profaning it
and in Pri Etz Chaim the wording is
from the accusation of the yetzer hara,
and he does not need the wine
And one who did not keep
for him the wine will not help;
and one who kept it properly
is saved from the sorrow of the Nachash,
